entries.zh: 压；往下压、压迫（L 栏释义 que abaxar「使下压」）
entries.en: to press down, oppress (oprimir; 'que abaxar': to bring down)
entries.notes: 西语缩写 q 之展开（que abaxar）依赖推断且有 [疑:q/e]；M 栏声调符 T99 污损仅及音，不碍字义。

entries.zh: 屈；屈曲、屈从，受压而不伸
entries.en: to bend, yield; to bow under pressure
entries.notes: 汉字 [疑:屈/压]，取屈从义；与 M 栏 cuǐ（khuí）音相合。

entries.zh: 制压；压制、压服（闽南语连读「制压」）
挟制；挟持以压，强加钳制
entries.en: to coerce, hold in check; to press by force
to wrong and crush people to death

entries.zh: 狂暴；狂怒凶暴、恶语相加（L 栏注明以恶言辱骂）
entries.en: furious, raving; to rage with abusive words

entries.zh: 强暴；强横凶暴，恃力欺压
entries.en: violent, brutal; to oppress by force

entries.zh: 恃大压小；倚仗权势地位压制弱小
entries.en: to rely on one's superiority to oppress the lesser (the superior crushing inferiors)

entries.zh: 挟制；压制弱小（与第 5 条互见）
entries.en: to coerce, hold the weaker in check

entries.zh: 经；经文、经书（祈祷经文、教义类书）
entries.en: scripture, classic text; prayer book, doctrine

entries.zh: 咒、咒语；西人所谓祈祷、教义，即华人自称之经咒
entries.en: incantation, spell; the term by which the Chinese call their own prayers or doctrine

entries.zh: 咒语；善咒吉语（L 栏 oraciones buenas「善祷」，R 栏注 buena）
entries.en: incantation, magical formula; good, beneficent prayers
entries.notes: 汉字 [疑:咀/咒]，依 L 栏 oraciones buenas 与 R 栏 buena 取善咒义。

entries.zh: 转状；向地狱牢狱呈递状文的祷仪（僧道为亡魂转呈诉状以求脱苦）
entries.en: petition-prayer passed on (to hell's prison) with a hermit; ritual plaint for release from hell
entries.notes: 西语 a la ca del inferno 之 ca 为截断缩写，疑为 cárcel（牢狱）之展开，释义依赖推断；末音声调符 T99。

entries.zh: 阿弥陀佛；对佛像（西人所谓偶像）所诵之祷词，即念佛号
entries.en: 'Amitabha Buddha'; the invocation made to the idol (Buddha image)
